correctness.rationale: Inspected the full all-parameter star/top-clique and Frobenius-characteristic argument in frozen RESULT.md and its independent finite checker source. For 3<=k<=n-3, maximal Johnson cliques are stars (fixed (k-1)-subset) and tops (fixed (k+1)-subset); faces of size>=3 lie uniquely in one, allowing elementary collapse to a connected 2-core. The hypersimplex's simply connected triangular 2-skeleton spanning the entire Johnson 1-skeleton gives pi1=0. Equivariant Euler characteristic then isolates actual H2 (not merely virtual Euler class), with signed edge module h_(k-1) h_(n-k-1) e2. Frobenius/Pieri or equivalent Jacobi-Trudi telescoping cancels 2-row/3-row partitions and yields each S^(n-j-2,j,1,1) once for 1<=j<=min(k,n-k)-1. Verified the n=6,k=3 dimensions 10+9=19 and denominator boundary k>n/2 through complement equivariance. Finitely tested characters are corroboration only; all-parameter scope follows from the symbolic proof. No integral Specht splitting claimed.
residual_risks: The uniform proof uses standard homotopy, Frobenius and Pieri identities; finite tests alone do not establish unbounded n.
